description: Answer both 'how bad did it get' and 'is it really diversified' for a built-in model portfolio, a canonical strategy or your own portfolio. Drawdowns: the deepest peak-to-trough episodes with months to trough and recovery, Ulcer index, longest time underwater, monthly VaR/CVaR 95, worst month and year, and returns in 2008, 2020 and 2022. Diversification: each holding's share of the risk next to its share of the money (60/40 is about 60% of the money and 93% of the risk), the number of independent bets over the full window, the last 10 years and the 36 months to Feb 2009 and Dec 2022, co-movement groups, near-duplicate pairs and the equal-risk weights. Correlations: the holdings' correlation matrix. Pass exactly one of `template` (e.g. classic-60-40, all-weather), `strategy` (e.g. faber-trend-timing) or `assets` (your own allocation, including nested portfolios, rotations and strategies as holdings via `sleeve`, with optional `rebalance` and `overlay`); list_portfolios shows valid ids. `sections` limits the output. Ids are precomputed from the monthly refresh (instant); `assets` are computed live, with independent bets over the full window (and the last 10 years for plain tickers); the 2008 and 2022 windows are computed for built-in portfolios only. Read-only. For headline CAGR/Sharpe use analyze_portfolio; for calendar returns use portfolio_returns.

assets.description: Your own allocation instead of an id, computed live (drawdowns, risk share, bets and correlations of your own mix). Same format as analyze_portfolio: plain tickers and nested portfolios, rotations or strategies via `sleeve`. Weights in percent, summing to ~100.

sleeve.description: Advanced: a strategy node instead of a plain ticker — the app's SleeveRef, resolved server-side. Supported: a rotation/selection (`{source:'selection', config:{universe:[{ticker}], signal:{kind:'indicator', indicatorId, params} | {kind:'trailing-return', lookbackMonths, skipMonths (>= 1; the ranking for a month only sees data through the previous month-end)}, topK, weighting, rebalance}, label}`), a strategy-over-node (`{source:'strategy-over', child:{ticker}, config:<BacktestConfig>, label}`), a saved strategy preset (`{source:'backtest-live', ticker, frequency, config, presetId, label}`), a curated public-library strategy (`{source:'backtest-public', strategyId, label}`), a published backtest share (`{source:'backtest-share', shareId, label}`), a gallery template (`{source:'portfolio-public', templateId, label}`), or a nested portfolio (`{source:'portfolio-mine', portfolioId, config, label}`). Strategies with a config get a node-level overfit check (a share carries only its frozen curve, so no overfit).

ticker.description: Yahoo Finance ticker, e.g. VTI, BND, GLD. Omit when `sleeve` is given.

episodes.description: How many of the deepest drawdown episodes to list (1-8). Default 5.

label.description: Optional display name for a custom `assets` portfolio. Default "Custom portfolio".

overlay.description: Optional portfolio-level trend-filter overlay applied to the WHOLE book: hold the entire portfolio only while its own level is above its N-month moving average, otherwise cash. Composition is monthly (a 10-month filter ≈ the classic 200-day one).

rebalance.description: Rebalancing cadence for custom portfolios (templates use their own).

sections.description: Which parts to return: drawdowns, diversification, correlations. Default: all three.

strategy.description: Canonical rule-based strategy id, e.g. 'faber-trend-timing'. A strategy is one rule-based line, so its diversification section is reported as not applicable.

template.description: Built-in model portfolio id, e.g. 'classic-60-40', 'all-weather', 'golden-butterfly'. list_portfolios shows all 19.

name: portfolio_risk
